chunks: Al-Sadiq Ja‘far ibn Muhammad (peace be upon them both) said to some of his companions:

When the eve of al-Fitr comes, pray the three units of Maghrib, then prostrate and say in your prostration: "O Possessor of everlasting bounty, O Possessor of power, O Selector of Muhammad and his supporter, bless Muhammad and the family of Muhammad, and forgive me every sin that I have committed and forgotten, while it is with You in a manifest book."
Then say one hundred times: "I repent to God."

And do takbir after Maghrib, the final Isha, the morning prayer, and the Eid prayer, just as you do takbir in the days of Tashriq, saying: "God is the Greatest, God is the Greatest, there is no god but God, and God is the Greatest, God is the Greatest, and to God belongs all praise, God is the Greatest for what He has guided us to, and praise be to God for what He has made us face."
But do not say in it: "and provide us from the cattle of livestock," for that is only for the days of Tashriq.

key_terms.التشريق: Tashriq: The three days following Eid al-Adha (11th-13th of Dhul Hijjah)
key_terms.الفطر: Al-Fitr: The breaking of the fast, referring to Eid al-Fitr that concludes Ramadan
key_terms.بهيمة الأنعام: Cattle of livestock: Refers to sacrificial animals, relevant to Eid al-Adha but not Eid al-Fitr
key_terms.كتاب مبين: A manifest/clear book: Refers to the divine record in which all deeds are preserved

ai.seo_question: What is the recommended supplication for the eve of Eid al-Fitr according to Imam al-Sadiq?
ai.summary: Imam al-Sadiq (AS) instructed his companions on the special acts of worship for the eve of Eid al-Fitr, which marks the end of Ramadan. The teaching includes a prostration supplication invoking God's everlasting grace and power, seeking forgiveness for all sins, followed by one hundred repetitions of repentance (istighfar). He also specified the Eid al-Fitr takbir formula to be recited after certain prayers, while clarifying the distinction from the Eid al-Adha (Tashriq) takbir which includes a mention of livestock.

en.bilal-muhammad: Al-Sadiq Ja`far b. Muhammad (as) said to some of his companions:

On the eve of al-Fitr, pray the three units of Maghrib, then prostrate and say the following in your prostration: “O Everlasting, O Powerful, O Selector and Supporter of Muhammad! Bless Muhammad and the Family of Muhammad and forgive me of every sin that I have committed and forgotten that is with You in the Manifest Book (Ya thal tawl, ya thal hawl, ya mustafi Muhammad wa nasirih, salli `ala Muhammad wa aali Muhammad, waghfir li kulli dhanbin adhnabtahu wa nasaytahu wa huwa `indika fii kitabin mubin).”
Then say the following one hundred times: “I repent to Allah” (atubu illallah),

and do takbir after al-Maghrib, the Final `Isha’, and morning prayer, and the Eid prayer, just as you do takbir in the days of Tashriq; saying: “Allah is the Greatest, Allah is the Greatest, there is no god but Allah. Allah is the Greatest, Allah is the Greatest, and to Allah is the Praise. Allah is the Greatest over what He has guided us to, and praise be to Allah over what He has made us face (Allahu akbar, Allahu akbar, la ilaha illallah, Allahu akbar, Allahu akbar, wa lillahil hamd. Allahu akbar `ala ma hadana, walhamdulillah `ala ma ablana).”
But, do not say: “Provide us with the cattle of livestock (warzuqna min bahimat al-an`am)”, for that is only for the days of Tashriq.
